notes: scan043.N1: The inline Hom(Z,A) ≃ A has a direct elementary check: a homomorphism from the additive infinite cyclic group is determined by the image a of 1, since its value at n is a^n; conversely n ↦ a^n defines a homomorphism for every a. Evaluation at 1 is therefore a bijection; it is a group isomorphism with pointwise multiplication when A is abelian. This checks only this elementary identification and does not establish the gerbe equivalence.

scan043.N2: The author continues the elementary S^2 example, identifies gerbe data with an automorphism of the trivial extension of Z by A, and writes (25), H^2(S^2,A) ≃ A, after visibly correcting the coefficient Z to A. The gerbe/extension identification and cohomology formula are carried as background here; no independent proof is supplied by this reading.

scan043.N3: The successful example is offered as support for an intuition about a theory of Lim of homotopy types and a van Kampen-style statement for a recollé topos. The wording is a proposal and confidence statement, not a proof on this page. Its general validity was not checked; no fault was found merely from the local transcription.

scan043.N4: Full page layout and both supplied full-resolution halves were visually read, including agreed text, all 17 body lines (16 prose lines and one display), superscripts, references, corrections and margin entries. There is no diagram or free drawing. All 19 saved working crops were inspected; an initial multi-image result was truncated by the context system, so unavailable images were subsequently displayed individually rather than recropped.

scan043.N5: Top 9 is dark authorial pagination. Bottom-left 42 is pale secondary foliation, preserved as a margin entry; the change from C mspage{42} to margin{42} is editorial encoding, not a change of numeral. The inserted de (23) and its leader are distinct from the top page number.

scan043.N6: At the first-pass stage, C first readings were substantively retained throughout. Blind adjudication subsequently added the tentative comma correction in r10; see N11. M0964 and M0965 are resolved to their first, underlined readings. Five other locations receive explicit additional uncertainty (inline Z font, overwritten Z font, struck limites inductives, des/de, avec/ou); the existing struck-sur uncertainty remains. These certainty-only alterations are not counted as substantive corrections to C.

scan043.N7: H differences include text not present at this page opening and before magnifique, colons for two compressed à forms, omitted deleted states, an invented separate les after des, lowercase top(o)s, usuels for recollé, and guillemets for straight quotation ticks. The des/de and avec/ou disputes remain open even though C is retained first. H underline omissions are documented separately from its uncertainty on à la van.

scan043.N8: The two lower Lim strokes have single downward terminals and no identifiable right-facing heads; the inserted Lim in line 11 has a separate shaft with a clear right arrowhead. This is an ink distinction, not an inferred mathematical normalization. The underlines beneath automorphisme and van Kampen likewise remain distinct from strike-throughs.

scan043.N9: Audit boxes use neutral names and full readings. b09 contains two complete adjacent lines to include both the no-un opening and the single live des without cutting long descenders. b11 is slightly taller than the working r12 crop to include all ascenders in the accompanying complete phrase.
